GitHub Actions version manager

Usage: actup [OPTIONS] [ACTION] [COMMAND]

Commands:
  check        Scan workflows and report outdated actions (non-destructive)
  update       Update actions to their latest versions
  fix          Alias for update
  pin          Pin all actions to their current SHA
  config       Show effective configuration
  schema       Output JSON schema for configuration
  cache        Manage the version cache
  completions  Generate shell completions
  help         Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Arguments:
  [ACTION]  Action to look up, e.g. `actions/checkout` or `actions/checkout@v4`

Options:
  -v, --verbose          Verbose output [env: ACTUP_VERBOSE=]
  -c, --config <PATH>    Config file to load over the repo and user config [env: ACTUP_CONFIG=]
      --color <WHEN>     When to colour output [env: ACTUP_COLOR=] [default: auto] [possible values:
                         auto, always, never]
      --offline          Use only cached version data; a ref missing from the cache is an
                         environment error
      --no-cache         Neither read nor write the version cache
      --refresh          Skip cached versions and write the freshly fetched ones
      --format <FORMAT>  Output format [default: human] [possible values: human, json, toml]
  -h, --help             Print help
  -V, --version          Print version
